audit.whatIsWrong: Chain Lash is called '(E)' and 'the E-Q whip', and the player is told to Wind Wall it in five places.
audit.why: Chain Lash is Q — a 775-range cross of chains at a target location with a delayed explosion, and it carries no projectile flag. The projectile in Sylas's kit is the Abduct recast on E, the chain he throws to pull himself to what it hits. That is what Wind Wall actually stops.
audit.corrected: Sidestep the Chain Lash intersection; save Wind Wall for the Abduct chain.

audit.whatIsWrong: Abscond / Abduct is described as 'his dash + stun' in the cooldown breakdown, dosFull[0] and report[5].
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.' There is no stun in his kit anywhere. The mirror audit removed four identical stun claims from the Sylas side.
audit.corrected: The chain pulls him to you — no stun; the danger is that his W lands in the same beat.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 text treats a stolen Last Breath as a fight-flipping threat.
audit.why: Last Breath blinks to an AIRBORNE enemy champion, and Sylas has no knockup of his own. Stolen from you it only casts off a teammate's displacement — the mirror calls this the most serious defect on that page.
audit.corrected: A stolen Last Breath is dead in his hands until an ally lands CC.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds is never mentioned in the content layer despite Kingslayer being the reason he wins long trades.
audit.why: The missing-interactions file flags Sylas as needing anti-heal: Kingslayer heals him against champions on a 12s cooldown at rank 1, falling to 6s.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal timing written into the spikes and wants.you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Yasuo four rows and Skill three.
audit.why: The already-audited sylas side flipped rows 0-5 to Sylas and left 2+ items with Yasuo.
audit.corrected: Rows realigned as matched full/content pairs with ratings and rewritten whys.

audit.why: Chain Lash 10s at rank 1, Kingslayer 12s at rank 1 down to 6s, Abscond/Abduct 13s at rank 1, Hijack 80/55/30s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into the spikes, mid and breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: Level 1 Sylas's poke needs Chain Lash, which your Windwall and dodges deny.
edits.after: Chain Lash (Q) pokes from 775 range and the wall does not stop it.

edits.before: At level 2 your E-Q out-trades him while his self-heal stays offline.
edits.after: Kingslayer heals him back up from every level-2 trade you take.

edits.before: Level 3 you keep punishing before his double E and W sustain scale.
edits.after: At level 3 his Abscond dash resets every trade you think you won.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 even to skill as his mobility and Kingslayer drain let him reset trades.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 his mobility and the Kingslayer drain reset every trade he loses.

edits.after: At 6 he steals an ultimate that can answer your all-in outright.

edits.after: His Kingslayer sustain and his two dashes outlast the burst of your first item.

edits.before: Early you out-trade him: E-Q onto Sylas and Wind Wall his Chain Lash (E-Q whip) so his double-tick poke and self-heal off Kingslayer (W) never come online. His damage is gated behind landing that whip; deny it with Windwall or a sidestep and he can only chip you with weak autos.
edits.after: Early he pokes with Chain Lash (Q, 10s at rank 1) from 775 range and no wall stops it — sidestep the intersection point, because the delayed explosion is where the damage sits. Kingslayer (W, 12s at rank 1) heals him off you, so carry Grievous Wounds before any long trade.

edits.before: Even and skill-based here — Sylas steals your R, Last Breath, and can turn a fight if he ults into a knock-up, so don't group up carelessly or feed him a stolen ult. Bait his E chains, Windwall the whip, and all-in only when his W heal and E dash are down.
edits.after: At 6 he steals Last Breath, but it blinks only to an airborne enemy and he has no knockup — it is dead in his hands until a teammate lands CC. Wind Wall the Abduct chain (his E recast), the one projectile he owns, and all-in when his W heal and E dash are down.

edits.before: Skill-dependent: Sylas is a slippery, self-healing bruiser-mage whose Kingslayer sustain and double E dashes let him reset trades. Windwall his poke, punish when his E is on cooldown, but respect that a fed Sylas out-sustains a coin-flip trade — pick clean windows.
edits.after: Skill-dependent: Sylas is a slippery, self-healing bruiser-mage whose Kingslayer sustain and E dash let him reset trades. Wall the Abduct chain, punish while his E sits on its 13s cooldown, and keep anti-heal up — a fed Sylas out-sustains any coin-flip trade.

edits.before: You edge it late if you punish his cooldowns: Windwall his Chain Lash and stolen ults, and dash onto him the moment his second E charge is spent. His whole kit hinges on E mobility and W drain, so catching him mid-cooldown deletes him with your crit DPS.
edits.after: You edge it late if you punish his cooldowns: Wind Wall the Abduct chain and dash onto him the moment his Abscond is spent. His whole kit hinges on that dash and the Kingslayer drain, so catching him mid-cooldown with anti-heal up deletes him.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are yours: Sylas's damage and self-heal both hinge on landing Chain Lash, so Windwall or dodge the whip and your E-Q trades chunk him while he can't answer.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are his: Chain Lash (Q) pokes from 775 range and no wall stops it, and Kingslayer (W) heals him straight back off you, so sidestep the intersection and trade in short bursts.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 even to skill — respect his Kingslayer sustain, his double E mobility, and the stolen R threat, so all-in only when his E and W are down.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 favour him — respect the Kingslayer sustain and the Abscond dash (13s at rank 1), and all-in only once both his E and W are spent.

edits.before: You edge it late by punishing cooldowns: Windwall his whip and stolen ults, dash in the instant his second E charge is spent, and your crit DPS deletes a slippery but squishy Sylas.
edits.after: You edge it late by punishing cooldowns: wall the Abduct chain, dash in the instant his Abscond is spent, keep Grievous Wounds on him, and your crit DPS deletes a slippery but squishy Sylas.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Abscond / Abduct: 13s at rank 1 — the dash, then a recast chain that pulls him to whatever it hits; it does not stun, and Wind Wall blocks that chain. - Kingslayer: 12s at rank 1, 6s at rank 5, and it heals him off you. - Hijack: 80s at rank 1.

edits.before: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His dash, then a chain pull — no stun anywhere. Bait it, then commit on its 13s cooldown.

edits.before: Sylas wastes Abscond / Abduct — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: The recast chain is a projectile — the wall eats his pull entirely.

edits.before: Track Sylas's Abscond / Abduct: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. When it is down — Dash-Q stack into EQ-knockup.
edits.after: Wind Wall eats the Abduct chain, not Chain Lash. His E does not stun. A stolen Last Breath needs an airborne enemy he cannot make.

notes: The full layer names the tracked ability 'Abscond / Abduct' throughout, which is correct for the E, but its description was the false 'dash + stun' in three fields — all three are corrected here. Left alone deliberately: whether Wind Wall can catch Chain Lash's chains at all. Riot's text describes chains intersecting at a targeted location rather than a travelling missile and the kit file gives it no projectile flag, so I neither asserted nor denied it beyond removing the instruction to rely on it.
